label: Bintan
short_description: Beach resorts along the Lagoi Bay strip on Bintan island in the Riau Islands.
intro: Bintan's hotels in this directory sit within the Lagoi resort enclave on the north coast of the Riau Islands' largest island -- a gated strip of beach resorts, golf courses and a town square, popular as a quick beach getaway from Singapore via the ferry to Bandar Bentan Telani (about an hour). The area suits self-contained beach-and-golf stays rather than city travel.
